audit.why: Favoured (53.11% WR, 4167 games): immobile artillery vs a dive kit — Sylas favoured every stage once he closes. Text matches.
Level chart is Sylas on all seven rows in full, content and packet — consistent. Spike text (bait E, level 6 optional Hijack, first-item kill window) matches the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Xerath's R is named 'Rite of the Ancients' in spikes[1].text, late and wants.foe[2]; the real name is Rite of the Arcane. Also cooldowns field carried no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: R = Rite of the Arcane (130/115/100s, self-immobilizing channel). E Shocking Orb 13s rank 1 is his only CC/escape — correctly identified as the matchup hinge.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1, barely 11s at max — his only CC. Dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill; that whole window is yours. - Your E Abscond has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - Your R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane sits on a 130-second timer — stolen at 6 it hands you free lane-long poke he can never dodge back.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: A hoarded Hijack is wasted tempo — even his Rite of the Arcane, stolen, is free siege poke you should be casting.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Xerath wins by keeping you at artillery range, chunking with Arcanopulse, and landing Shocking Orb on your dash.

edits.before: You do not need R Hijack to kill him, though stealing Rite of the Ancients gives you free long-range poke for the lane. Your standard combo already deletes his squishy frame once his E stun is spent.
edits.after: You do not need R Hijack to kill him, though stealing Rite of the Arcane gives you free long-range poke for the lane. Your standard combo already deletes his squishy frame once his E stun is spent.

edits.before: Even with items Xerath can chunk you from off-screen with Arcanopulse and Rite of the Ancients, so never walk the poke straight-on. Use Abduct from a flank or fog angle to close the gap in one motion, and once you land it he has no way to escape your burst. Hijacking a key enemy ult adds teamfight value while his own kit stays purely a ranged nuisance you can dodge.
